**The supervised price for transferring securities to the client's own account elsewhere** ("(בפיקוח)"). Not in the rules; BoI supervised-price notices or each bank's tariff part 4(א)(6). **[2026-10-26 open-questions audit]** Still open, narrowed. The Bank of Israel's position filed in court on 9.5.21 (on the parallel supervised service "העברת מטבע חוץ בארץ לחשבון אותו לקוח") explains the mechanism: services under a supervision order before Amendment 12 of the Banking (Service to Customer) Law are supervised services under s.9יא, the list was published on 6.4.2007, and where no amount was set under s.9יב the transitional provision applies s.9יג, so "המחיר קובע (was fixed) למחיר שנהג בכל בנק במועד ההכרזה על השירות כמפוקח" and a rise needs the Supervisor's approval ([בנק ישראל: עמדה מטעם הגורם המאסדר, ת"צ 22486-04-20](https://www.boi.org.il/media/e4xji1rw/202207.pdf), p.1, paras 1-2 · checked 2026-10-26 · primary). If the securities transfer was declared supervised the same way, there is no single amount in an order and each bank's price is its own frozen price; not confirmed for securities. Would settle it: the Supervisor's 2007/2008 list of supervised services and any s.9יב order for "העברת ניירות ערך".
